title: US Climate Alliance (experimental whole-US proxy)
attribution: World Climate Simulation materials by Climate Interactive, MIT Sloan, and the UMass Lowell Climate Change Initiative. Updated November 2025. Adapted for nested-agent experiments.
goals: Show continued American support for the Paris Agreement
Influence official parties toward ambitious action
Share clean technologies and manufacturing to reduce transition costs
negotiating_constraints: Official briefing grants no formal negotiating standing, only influence
Subnational actors cannot bind the federal government or the whole US region
opportunities: State and city clean energy policies
Broad coalitions of businesses and institutions
adaptation_notes: Goals and qualitative constraints paraphrase the briefing. Baseline commitments, numeric ceilings, finance-role restrictions, personalities and scoring are author-created experimental assumptions, NOT official prescribed positions. Source text reflects November 2025 and is not a live policy fact-check. This variant deliberately grants a hypothetical whole-US proxy role to a coalition that has NO official negotiating standing in the source. Results must not be described as binding US commitments.
